name: Submit new sitemap URLs to IndexNow

parameters.content:
## Submit new pages to IndexNow
Every hour it reads your sitemap, finds URLs it has not seen before and submits them to IndexNow, which shares them with Bing, Yandex, Seznam and other search engines.

1. In **Settings**, set your `sitemapUrl` and your IndexNow `key`.
2. Host the key file at https://yourdomain/<key>.txt containing only the key.
3. Activate the workflow. The first run only remembers your current URLs; later runs submit new ones.

Remembered URLs are kept in the workflow's static data, which n8n saves on active (production) runs only, not on manual test runs. No credentials needed.
